node_definition.done_when:
Under routing.picker: route (the shipped default since merge 4cb06a148), reckon/cli.py crew_dispatch sets availability_refusal = None whenever effective_route == "picker". The deterministic model-availability refusal (_model_availability_refusal, exit 5, competence-refusal) is therefore skipped for whichever backend the dispatch ends up using. The picker's own filter reads only cached observations, and a model with no cached probe reads "unknown" and stays eligible. So a dispatch with no lane named, whose default backend serves a model the account does not serve, sails past the refusal deterministic routing would give. Measured at the merged head of main plus explicit-lane-implies-deterministic: tests/test_every_dry_run_refusal_carries_the_echo.py::test_a_dry_run_availability_refusal_carries_the_echo (no --local, no --backend; host flight model unserved-gamma) expects exit 5 and gets exit 2. The run reaches contract validation with picker_selection action fallback (jev-error: ValueError) to that same backend.

Required behaviour: the picker never makes a dispatch worse than deterministic routing. Whatever backend the dispatch resolves to under the picker route, the deterministic availability check applies to that backend, with the same exit code and payload as on the deterministic path, and the picker_selection stays recorded on the refusal payload. This covers a picker route to a named backend, a fallback to the default backend, and a refusal that falls through to the default. Live picks must not pay a fresh availability probe per candidate: probe only the one backend the dispatch will use, as the deterministic path does today.

Confirm the defect reproduces at the base first: that echo test must fail there. Add tests/test_picker_route_keeps_availability_refusal.py with three cases. First, a route-mode dry run whose picker falls back to an unserved default backend refuses with exit 5. Second, a route-mode dispatch whose picker routes to an unserved backend refuses with exit 5 and names that backend. Third, a served backend still dispatches.

Gate: that file, tests/test_every_dry_run_refusal_carries_the_echo.py, tests/test_routing_explicit_lane_implies_deterministic.py, tests/test_routing_picker_key.py and tests/test_routing_picker_default.py. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider, one log for base and one for head under the run directory, judged by delta. The coordinator runs the dispatch population at merge.
